disposition_reason: Single composite values for nine vegetables and fruits from four Bangalore Rural taluk markets, analysed for six elements by ICP-MS.

study.design: market survey, composite samples per food per taluk market
study.market: markets of Nelamangala, Doddaballapura, Devanahalli and Hosakote taluks, Bangalore Rural district, Karnataka, India
study.method: ICP-MS per FSSAI Manual 2016 Method 3 after rinsing, air- and oven-drying (100 C) and grinding
study.lod_text: not reported (values below detection printed as BDL)
study.qa: NIST-grade standard solutions for calibration only; no CRM or recovery reported
